title: Contents Packout & Storage Packing Price List
content:
These are the Contents Packout & Storage packing rates of each tier: one rate per box size, wardrobe box, furniture item, crate, electronics item and itemized high-value inventory item. A figure of 0.00 in the table means the tier carries no rate for that line.

## Unit rates (USD)

| Packing line | On-Site Contents Manipulation | In-Plant Contents Cleaning | Partial Contents Packout | Full Contents Packout | High-Value Contents Packout | Commercial Contents and Records Recovery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pack, inventory and move out per small box (1.5 cubic feet) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 14.85 | 14.85 | 16.40 | 13.95 |
| Pack, inventory and move out per medium box (3.0 cubic feet) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 19.60 | 19.60 | 21.65 | 18.40 |
| Pack, inventory and move out per large box (4.5 cubic feet) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 24.30 | 24.30 | 26.85 | 22.85 |
| Pack, inventory and move out per wardrobe box | 0.00 | 0.00 | 31.75 | 31.75 | 34.90 | 29.80 |
| Blanket wrap and move out per furniture item | 0.00 | 0.00 | 38.50 | 38.50 | 44.25 | 36.20 |
| Custom crate built for art, mirrors or glass per crate | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 168.00 | 168.00 | 168.00 |
| Pack and move out per electronics item with tagging of cables | 0.00 | 0.00 | 22.40 | 22.40 | 26.80 | 19.95 |
| Itemized photo inventory and condition report per high-value item | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 18.50 | 12.75 |

## Notes to the price list

1. Custom crates carry no rate on Partial Contents Packout, and the itemized high-value inventory line carries a rate only on High-Value Contents Packout and Commercial Contents and Records Recovery.
2. Neither On-Site Contents Manipulation nor In-Plant Contents Cleaning carries a rate for any packing line.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On a tier whose medium box rate were 10.00 (not a figure from this list), a packing line of 7 medium boxes would be 7 times 10.00, or 70.00.
